events.title: Timor-Leste certified malaria-free by WHO
events.description: The World Health Organization (WHO) has certified Timor-Leste as malaria-free, a remarkable achievement for a country that prioritized the disease and embarked on a concerted, nation-wide response shortly after gaining independence in 2002. “WHO congratulates the people and government of…

signals.title: Internet connectivity drop measured in Timor-Leste
signals.limitations: Measured by bgp. Only one measurement method fired, which can be a measurement artefact. A measured drop is not a confirmed outage or shutdown until an operator or authority reports it.
